package http

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
)

type studentCoursesHTTPStub struct {
	studentID string
	courseID  string
}

func (stub *studentCoursesHTTPStub) List(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
) ([]domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	stub.studentID = studentID
	return []domain.StudentCourseAssignment{{
		ID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", StudentID: studentID,
		CourseID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Status: domain.CourseAssignmentAssigned,
		AssignedBy:               domain.CourseAssignmentSourceLearningPlanner,
		InitialPlanningRequestID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", AssignedAt: time.Now(),
	}}, nil
}

func (stub *studentCoursesHTTPStub) Get(
	_ context.Context,
	studentID string,
	courseID string,
) (domain.StudentCourseAssignment, error) {
	stub.studentID, stub.courseID = studentID, courseID
	return domain.StudentCourseAssignment{StudentID: studentID, CourseID: courseID}, nil
}

func TestStudentCourseRoutesUseTrustedOwnerIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	courses := &studentCoursesHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(RouterDependencies{
		AnswerHandler:                  &handlers.AnswerHandler{},
		StudentCourseAssignmentHandler: &handlers.StudentCourseAssignmentHandler{Courses: courses},
	})
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/api/v1/student/courses", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111")
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || courses.studentID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d owner=%s body=%s", response.Code, courses.studentID, response.Body.String())
	}
}
